headline: The database tier is down from the only vantage and its container is gone on <app-host> while the host, the routers, and the flows are clean; the loss follows change:<sha> on <dc-leaf> and reaches the api and web tiers and the Order Management service.

application.trend_note: Three visits on the ring; the baseline and the second visit were clean, this one flipped one probe and lost one container.
application.impression: The database tier stopped answering from the cloud vantage at the same visit its container disappeared from <app-host>; web and api still answer, the host is up with no interface down. This is the container, not the host and not the path.
evidence_for: annotations[] carries change:<sha> at 15:20, inside the window
evidence_against: host:<app-host> up, boot_epoch unchanged, interfaces_down empty
probes web and api up at 200 from the same vantage
application.inspect_when: Open when the nurse's per-row notes or the scrape-target errors are needed.

netflow.trend_note: Four visits; both resolved exporters reporting every window, conversation set stable, no 4x byte move.
netflow.impression: North-south flows toward <app-host> are unchanged; the exporters see nothing different. Consistent with a failure inside the host rather than on the way to it.
evidence_for: conversation rows with dst_device <app-host> present, bytes within band
evidence_against: east-west tier traffic is not exported, so the api -> database path is invisible here
netflow.inspect_when: Open when per-conversation byte counts are needed.

splunk.trend_note: Two visits; per-device counts flat, no bgp or link row reached the flap threshold, no config row.
splunk.impression: Router syslog is quiet. No config event on <dc-leaf> in the window despite the change annotation, which means the change was applied through the pipeline, not interactively.
evidence_for: no bgp, link, reload, or config row on <dc-leaf> or the edges
splunk.inspect_when: Open when mnemonic samples or auth events are needed.

iosxe.trend_note: One visit on the ring since the board was reset; no baseline for counters yet.
iosxe.impression: Interfaces up, BGP established, counters flat on <dc-leaf> and the edges at the last visit, which is four hours older than the symptom.
evidence_for: board rows for <dc-leaf> interfaces oper up, errors 0
evidence_against: the last device visit predates change:<sha> and the probe flip
iosxe.inspect_when: Open when per-interface counters or ACL hit counts are needed.

servicenow.trend_note: Three visits; one new incident this window naming the database tier, no change request row.
servicenow.impression: A new incident reports orders failing; its typed service column is Order Management and its issue text names the database tier. No CHG covers change:<sha>, so the change is a pipeline commit without a ticket.
evidence_for: incident:<inc-a> service column Order Management, issue names the database tier, opened 15:40, state New
evidence_against: no change row active, no rfc on the incident
servicenow.inspect_when: Open when the nurse's per-ticket notes are needed.

ticket_history.pattern: Fresh incident on the Order Management service; no change record for the pipeline commit.
ticket_history.summary: One new incident on Order Management names the database tier in its issue text; nothing else moved.
